challenge.method: Compare ordered lowercase ASCII alphanumeric runs from the publisher title through The End with both complete SPDX text payloads. Retain the edition line, copyright, Artistic License note, and closing marker. Test the cross-reference flag and a tokenizer that keeps internal apostrophes and hyphens. Recompute the full capture hashes and compare both SPDX URL pins with the annotated tag target.
challenge.results: All three sequences match at 868 tokens. The alternate tokenizer gives 859 in all three. The SPDX cross-reference records match=false for the historical OpenLDAP locator, while the captured file at that same repository revision reproduces the full bounded sequence. The publisher file differs in wrapping and spacing and has no extra words outside the passage. The decoded SPDX licenseText is byte-identical to the SPDX text file.

limitations: The token count uses runs of ASCII letters and digits with punctuation as a delimiter. It addresses documentary correspondence for this captured edition.

The SPDX files share one data commit and one text payload. Index lifecycle assignments, legal equivalence, rights for other works, reuse and installation are outside the finding. The supplied sources contain no Index lifecycle record.
